intro.h2: Kitchens, baths and the random projects in between
paragraphs: DMP Remodels does kitchen and bath remodeling in Batavia, IL, and it does not stop there. One client says he has thrown "various, random projects" at the team, and every one was done quickly and better than he expected.

Darren leads the work, and clients name him in their reviews. When one family had water damage and was living in a hotel, his team got the work done in a short amount of time, which helped them out. It was their second time hiring DMP, and that is a pattern in our reviews: clients who call back for the next job.

items.name: Kitchen remodeling
items.blurb: Kitchen updates from cabinets and countertops to backsplash and flooring. The open kitchen in our photos shows the look: white cabinets, a center island, recessed lighting and wood-look floors running into the dining area. Kitchen remodels are one of the topics reviewers mention most.

image.alt: Remodeled white kitchen with a center island, stainless refrigerator and wood-look floor opening to a dining table

items.name: Bathroom remodeling
items.blurb: Bathrooms where the small choices match. On one recent vanity, the brown veining in the top ties into matching veining in the backsplash, so the whole room feels intentional rather than pieced together. Bathroom remodels come up as often as kitchens in our Google reviews.

image.ai_prompt: Photorealistic photo of a finished bathroom in a 1990s two-story suburban home in the western suburbs of Chicago: a white shaker vanity with a white quartz top with soft brown veining, a matching full-height backsplash with the same brown veining, a matte black faucet, a framed round mirror, warm white walls, light oak-look floor tile, warm taupe and deep brown accents in towels, soft natural daylight from a window, uncluttered, no people, no faces, no text, no logos, no brand names, 4:3 aspect ratio.
image.alt: White vanity with a brown-veined top and matching backsplash (illustration)

items.name: Custom carpentry and woodwork
items.blurb: Custom woodworking and carpentry are part of what DMP does, and it shows in the trim work. Our photos include a white shiplap fireplace wall with a rustic wood mantel on black brackets, and a black geometric accent wall with wainscoting beside a staircase.

image.alt: White shiplap fireplace wall with a rustic wood mantel on black brackets beside navy painted walls

items.name: Walls, drywall and repairs
items.blurb: Older walls hide surprises. On one job we yanked out wood paneling and found a time capsule of drywall disasters underneath, so we skim coated the walls smooth. We also handle repairs after water damage, including for clients who need to get back home quickly.

image.alt: Staircase with wood treads, black iron balusters and a black geometric trim accent wall

items.name: Doors and smaller projects
items.blurb: Front door installation comes up in our reviews, and one homeowner says his new door turned out perfectly. If you have a list of odd jobs around the house, send it over. One client recommends DMP to anyone looking to have literally anything done in their home.

items.title: Clients come back
items.text: Repeat customers show up in our reviews. One family hired us a second time after water damage, and another client keeps sending us one project after another.

items.title: Work gets done fast
items.text: Timely completion is a review topic on our Google profile. When a family was living in a hotel during repairs, finishing in a short amount of time mattered, and Darren's team got it done.

items.title: You deal with Darren
items.text: Reviewers name Darren directly and describe him as very nice and pleasant to work with. You talk to the person running the job, not a call center.

items.title: Every review is five stars
items.text: DMP Remodels holds a 5.0 rating across 16 Google reviews, covering kitchen remodels, bathroom remodels, front doors and repair work.

about.text: DMP Remodels describes itself as custom woodworking, carpentry and remodeling, and it takes on custom home and business remodeling around Batavia and Naperville. Darren leads the team. One client calls him very nice and pleasant to work with, and another says his team finished every project quickly. The replies to reviews are personal, like the note thanking a homeowner for letting the team help bring the old charm back into his house. Our posts share the same focus: fix what is hiding behind the walls, and get the little details right so a space feels intentional.

image.alt: Shiplap fireplace wall with a rustic wood mantel built against navy walls

process.h2: How a project with us works

steps.title: Call or email
steps.text: Reach Darren at (708) 415-1719 or DMPRemodels@gmail.com, Monday to Friday between 10 AM and 6 PM, and tell us what you have in mind.

steps.title: Look at the space
steps.text: We walk through the room with you, talk through layout and finishes, and point out anything that needs fixing before new work goes in.

steps.title: Plan and price
steps.text: You get a clear scope for the job so you know what is included, what materials are going in and what it will take to finish.

steps.title: Build and fix what we find
steps.text: The team does the work. If old paneling hides damaged drywall, we deal with it properly, like the skim coat on our stairway job.

steps.title: Final walkthrough
steps.text: We go over the finished space with you together, check the details, and make sure you are happy before we call the job done.

service_area.h2: Kitchen and bath remodeling in Batavia, IL and Naperville
service_area.text: DMP Remodels works in the Batavia and Naperville area and takes on home and business remodeling projects there. If you are close by and not sure whether your address is in range, call (708) 415-1719 and ask. The same goes for job size: kitchens, bathrooms, front doors, trim and repair work are all on the list, so describe what you need.

items.q: What kinds of projects do you take on?
items.a: Kitchen and bathroom remodeling, custom cabinets, countertops, backsplash and flooring, plus custom carpentry like fireplace walls and trim. We also install front doors and repair walls after water damage. One client says he has sent us various random projects and every one was finished quickly.

DMP Remodels works in the Batavia and Naperville area of Illinois. Our Instagram lists Batavia and our Facebook page lists Naperville. If you live nearby and want to check whether we can reach you, give us a call at (708) 415-1719.

We are open Monday through Friday from 10 AM to 6 PM and closed on Saturday and Sunday. You can call (708) 415-1719 during those hours, or email DMPRemodels@gmail.com with a short description of the job and a few photos whenever it suits you.

items.q: How do I get a price for my project?
items.a: Call (708) 415-1719 or email DMPRemodels@gmail.com with a short description of the job and a few photos if you have them. We will set up a time to look at the space and then put together a price for the work.

items.q: Can you help after water damage?
items.a: Yes. One of our Google reviews comes from a family who had water damage and was living in a hotel while the work was done. They say Darren got it finished in a short amount of time. It was the second time they had hired us.

final_cta.h2: Have a kitchen, bath or odd job in mind?
final_cta.text: Call Darren and tell us about it. We answer Monday to Friday, 10 AM to 6 PM.
